channel.description: Latest articles from The Logical Indian (thelogicalindian.com)

item.title: Supreme Court Withdraws Protection for BS-III Diesel over 10 years, Petrol over 15 in Delhi-NCR Air Pollution Crackdown
item.description: Supreme Court lifts safeguards for high-polluting BS-III end-of-life vehicles in Delhi-NCR smog crisis, enforcing scrappage now.

item.title: Bangladesh: Dhaka Police Halt Protesters Marching To Indian High Commission; India Closes Visa Centre Amid Tensions
item.description: Police blocked protesters marching toward the Indian High Commission in Dhaka, Bangladesh. Read full details here.

item.title: Bulletproof Scorpio Tries to Run Over MDU Rohtak Students in Violent Clash, 2 Arrested Amid Old Feud
item.description: Parking dispute at MDU Rohtak erupts: Bulletproof Scorpio rams students, injures 2, 2 arrested for murder bid.

item.title: Pakistan Books Imran Khan’s Sisters, PTI Leaders Under Anti-Terrorism Act After Adiala Jail Entry-Denial Protest
item.description: Pakistan police charge Imran Khan’s sisters and PTI leaders under the Anti-Terrorism Act following a protest over denied jail visits, with 14 arrests signalling deepening political strife.

item.title: Kolkata Launches Rs 12.5 Lakh Tree Ambulance to Protect 6% Vulnerable Trees Amid 30% Green Cover Loss
item.description: Kolkata's groundbreaking free Tree Ambulance service responds to distressed public trees with expert care, tackling low green cover and storm risks via a toll-free SOS line.

item.title: USA: Minneapolis Police Chief Slams ICE After Video Shows Agent Dragging Woman Through Snowy Street
item.description: Minneapolis Police Chief Brian O’Hara criticised ICE agents after viral footage showed an officer dragging a woman.

item.title: UP Police Launch ‘Operation Torch’ in Varanasi, Conduct Door-to-Door Checks to Identify Illegal Immigrants
item.description: UP Police's 'Operation Torch' Verifies 10,000 Varanasi Homes for Illegal Immigrants, 80% Comply Amid Security Push.

item.title: Delhi Teacher Wins Hearts After Video Shows Her Silently Guiding Students From Behind Stage Prop
item.description: A viral video shows a Delhi teacher discreetly guiding students from behind a stage prop during a dance.

item.title: 64 Dead in 45 Bus Fires: Rajasthan’s 45 Fatalities Spark Urgent Safety Overhaul Demand
item.description: Official eDAR figures expose Rajasthan's deadly bus fire epidemic, claiming 45 of India's 64 fatalities since 2022, amid calls for urgent safety reforms.

item.title: UP Horror: Man Allegedly Kills Wife, Two Daughters in Lakhimpur Kheri for Refusing to Wear Burqas, Investigation Underway
item.description: A Lakhimpur Kheri man confessed to murdering his wife and two young daughters over their refusal to wear burqas, burying the bodies in his courtyard before police exhumation.
